test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
** Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

The mayor said to the marshals, “Don’t conduct any drill tomorrow.”

options.text: The mayor ordered the marshals not to conduct any drill the previous day.
The mayor ordered the marshals not to conduct any drill tomorrow.
The mayor ordered the marshals not to conduct any drill the next day.
The mayor ordered the marshals not to conducted any drill the next day.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **The mayor ordered the marshals not to conduct any drill the next day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in** direct speech**. We need to change it into** indirect speech.**
 
• Rules to change these types of questions:
 
• **'Said to' **will get replaced with '**ordered**' as the reported verb has an object.
 
• **'Don't'** will get replaced with** 'not to'**
 
• **'Tomorrow' **changes to **'the next day'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 

**Correct Indirect form**__: *The mayor ordered the marshals not to conduct any drill the next day.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Direct speech:A direct speech reports the precise words used by a speaker or writer.
 
• Indirect Speech: Indirect speech focuses more on the content of what someone said rather than their exact words.
